Images 4 to 7 are labelled examples from other places, each drawn like image 2 (the centre of a native square enlarged 4 times), at the same metres per pixel as image 1 and turned so the sun comes from the same side as in images 1 and 2. A hardware example shows a known piece of manufactured hardware; a natural example shows a natural feature that a detector flagged. Use them only to calibrate how each kind looks at this scale and light; judge the object at the centre of image 1. The examples are, in order: image 4 natural example, image 5 natural example, image 6 hardware example, image 7 hardware example.
